canada.title: Montreal byelections crucial for rebuilding NDP, party leader Avi Lewis says
canada.summary: Avi Lewis said a win in either Montreal byelection would be "incredible" but he sees these contests — and the four others taking place across Canada on Dec. 7 — as a means to continue building up the NDP's support base for the next general election.

canada.title: Fire in downtown Moncton closes streets surrounding restaurant
canada.summary: A fire in a house and restaurant in downtown Moncton forced the closure of surrounding streets on Thursday morning as firefighters battled the flames.

canada.title: Top court won’t hear bid for class-action lawsuit on behalf of Indigenous children
canada.summary: OTTAWA - The Supreme of Court of Canada will not hear a bid to certify a class-action lawsuit against Ottawa on behalf of Indigenous children who were taken from their families while living away from reserves and placed in non-Indigenous care.

canada.title: Medicine Hat releases review of suspected drowning of child at regional park
canada.summary: The City of Medicine Hat has released the findings of an independent review into the suspected drowning of an 11-year-old child during a field trip to Echo Dale Regional Park in June.

canada.title: PAL Airlines pilots are voting on whether to go on strike — potentially stopping flights next month
canada.summary: After failed negotiations with their employer, PAL Airlines pilots are participating in a strike authorization vote — potentially stopping flights next month.

canada.title: Language issues continue to dog Quebec accused murderer’s court appearances in N.L.
canada.summary: A Quebec man accused of first-degree murder in Happy Valley-Goose Bay, N.L., continues to experience problems after electing to have his case tried in French, including a Crown prosecutor not comfortable speaking “legal French,” and issues with members in the courtroom being able to understand an interpreter.
